field_contract.housing_unit_change: percent change: 2000 housing units to 2020-24 estimate
field_contract.rental_cost_change: percent change: 2000 median gross rent to 2020-24 estimate; nominal dollars
field_contract.home_value_change: percent change: 2000 median home value to 2020-24 estimate; nominal dollars
field_contract.employment_density: 2023 total jobs divided by 2020 Census land area, jobs per square mile
field_contract.neighborhood_trend_year: 2024, endpoint of current 2020-24 ACS estimate window
field_contract.owner_occupied_share: Owner Occupied Units / (Owner Occupied Units + Renter-Occupied Units) × 100; cross-checked to published Homeownership Rate
field_contract.renter_occupied_share: Renter-Occupied Units / (Owner Occupied Units + Renter-Occupied Units) × 100
field_contract.housing_cost_burden_share: published 2020-24 % of Households Housing Cost-Burdened, percentage points
field_contract.walking_to_work_share: published 2020-24 % of employed workers age 16 and older walking to work, percentage points; mobility statistic, not a generalized walkability score

municipal_housing_profile_compatibility.source_contract: official DCA Neighborhood Trends municipality values, not Power BI extraction

excluded_fields.eviction_rate: DCA Municipal Housing Profile documentation identifies eviction filtering at ZIP geography; not converted to municipality scope.
excluded_fields.housing_production: Catalog label is broader than a single proven workbook field; no synthetic alias is emitted.

excluded_catalog_fields.commute_mode_mix: No exact municipality-level commute-mode mix field in the 2026 workbook contract.
excluded_catalog_fields.real_estate_tax_median: No exact municipality-level median real-estate-tax field in the 2026 workbook contract.
excluded_catalog_fields.walkability_score: Workbook publishes % Walking to Work; Watchdog does not relabel this mobility statistic as a generalized walkability score.
